ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a predominantly low-intensity black background (estimated 65-70% surface area) punctuated by high-intensity white pixel clusters and ring-like shapes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Densely packed white circular annuli and irregular mottling concentrated on the distal and medial portions of both lobes, with a marked decrease in white pixel density approaching the fluke-to-peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate 45-degree interior angle and a high depth-to-span ratio relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge; the right lobe displays high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks, while the left lobe exhibits a prominent deep indentation approximately 15% inward from the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-phasic curve consisting of a concave arc originating at the median notch that transitions into a convex curve toward the outer lobe apices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of high-contrast white ring-shaped pixel clusters (ranging from 5 to 35 pixels in diameter) across approximately 80% of the visible ventral surface, indicating heavy past colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical high-intensity linear streaks visible on the medial-left lobe, disrupting the primary dark pigmentation mapping.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch or tissue loss on the far-left lobe tip and pervasive circular scarring across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and dense 'doughnut-shaped' white ring distribution that creates a high-frequency visual texture across the ventral surface.
